title: Skills
summary: Install skills (folders with a SKILL.md), and Jev picks the one that fits each request and tells the agent to follow it.
usage: Open Settings › Skills and click Install from folder to choose a skill folder or a folder of skills, or paste the text of a SKILL.md. Turn a skill off to leave it out, or remove it. When a skill is used, the request shows a Skill step. Changes apply only when you click Save settings. Mods can also bring skills; manage those in Settings › Mods. MCP servers that come with a skill reach the agent only when that skill is picked, and only if Approve MCP servers is on for that agent.
